text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You... back again? If you think you're gonna
get doted on like last time, you've got another thing coming—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Fine, I get it.
I just need to pet you, right? Just pet you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...*Sigh*. I wish everyone in the world
were as carefree as you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Not saying unnecessary things, not making fun of me,
just accepting me as I am—

Narita Taishin had so much fun taking photos
while playing with the cats after that
that she completely forgot all about training...
